zh: 每组恰好 k 个元素，所以首先 n 必须能被 k 整除，组数是 n/k；同一个值在一组里最多出现一次。
一个值出现的次数如果超过组数 n/k，就必然有一组放了两个它；反过来只要每个值都不超过组数，把相同值轮流分到不同组就能凑满每一组。
检查 n%k==0；统计每个值的出现次数并取最大值；若最大出现次数≤n/k 输出 Yes，否则输出 No。子序列只要求保持原下标顺序，分好组后按下标排序即可，不需要真的构造。
en: Every group has exactly k elements, so n must be divisible by k and there are n/k groups; a value can appear at most once inside one group.

If some value occurs more often than the n/k groups, two copies must land in the same group. Conversely, if no value exceeds the number of groups, dealing equal values round-robin into different groups fills every group exactly.

Check n % k == 0; count occurrences of each value and take the maximum; print Yes if the maximum is at most n/k, otherwise No. Subsequences only need the original index order, so after grouping you would just sort each group by index; no construction is needed.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Check that n is divisible by k and that no value occurs more often than the number of groups n/k.

## Proof of correctness

Necessity: every group has length k and a value can appear at most once per group. Sufficiency: process the occurrences grouped by value and deal them round-robin into the n/k groups; since no value exceeds the number of groups, no group gets a duplicate; the total is k times the number of groups, so after the round-robin every group has exactly k items. Sorting each group by original index gives a valid subsequence, so the condition is sufficient.

## Complexity

O(n) expected time, O(number of distinct values) space.
